name: Canvas Tool Bag
description: A canvas tool bag carried by Kell into the community radio studio during an emergency. It is transported to the water tower catwalk where it swings in the wind during antenna installation work.
narrative_significance: Functional prop used during emergency radio relay setup. Kell carries it as part of equipment needed to establish communication during a crisis when cell towers are down and the bridge is closed. Its presence at the water tower indicates it contains tools necessary for the antenna installation work.
